[b]Chimú myth of creation.[/b]
[i]At the begining of times there was nothing, nothing but Wacháy, at the same time he was nothing, he was everything, soon he discovered his power of creation, and created Camác, mother Erene, Kon, the god of winds, and Samantemán, the god of rains and sea, and as well the waqas Acachi Ururi, the morningstar, and Apadri Ururi, the star of afternoon, after creating everything, Wacháy became very tired and decided to take a rest, his throne become the mountains beyond the Chimor limits at south.
Kon took the throne of his father at the top of the southern mountains and named it Chomuñapu, the elder mountains, alongside Camác, he had two sons, Chilla and Chatay, the moon and the sun, who raised to the skies to illuminate the world, brighter than Apadri and Acachi, they however decided to fight back and had inumerous kids, called Patas, or the stars, who illuminate at the night as a try to overcome Chilla at night.
After this, Kon and Camác created the first beings to inhabit Erene, people with feathers, they were agile and boneless, just like Kon, in an act of envy, Samantemán made a massive tsunami and floods to destroy the creatures, those who survived were transformed by Camác in monkeys so they would escape to the trees to survive.
Furious by his brother's atitude, Kon decided to create giant beings, the second era began, the giants were enormous and robust, their resistence would make them survive the strong sea waves and the tsunamis, they were however, dependent of eating fruits from enormous trees of the time.
Samantemán once again destroyed Kon's creation and made the soil dry due the lack of rains, and without the trees, the giants went extinct, Kon and Camác however decided to counter Samantemán, Kon descended from his throne to the Earth, piercing the clouds on his agile form, an humanoid being with a cat face and  feathers of bird.
A great war began, Samantemán was as strong as Kon, and the war lasted years, Samantemán's blood became the rivers washing our planet, every strike done would make the entire universe trembled, while everytime the deities were pushed to sea, Camác created  islands in order to support Kon, Samantemán was finally defeated when his eyes got pierced by Kon, and was banished to the profound sea and chained in the  seas by algae created by Camác herself, Samantemán however still try to get freed by sending massive rains and tsunamis to Erene, and if he get free somehow, the entire humanity may get extinct unless Kon intervene.
Samantemán then created Muyvery , the waqa of the sea creatures, such as crustaceans and fish, however he went against his father's will and decided to help humanity, his other son was Cochanamo, who was god of sea and lakes, but he also went against his father and joined Kon.
All humans were created after the battle of brothers, and inhabit Erene until today, Camác and Kon had other kids such as Anecáp, godness of thunder , she substitued Samantemán and became godness of rain, Sansácun the godness of fire, Chilla and Chatay had Moyco, god of animals, and Sheuco god of climate.
[/i]
